title: aperiodic-co-classifying-invariant
description: The cosheaf-homology dual of the aperiodic classifying invariant: it records an aperiodic settling's MLD-class as a homology class H_1 built from cosheaf cycles, generated as the spatial Verdier-duality image of the sheaf-cohomology classifying invariant on the bitopological settling site.

dual-of.description: the aperiodic classifying invariant cl-inv(v) in H^1 whose Verdier-dual image this co-invariant is

homology-class.description: the co-invariant lives in cosheaf homology H_1(T*_{<=omega_1}, F^v) rather than sheaf cohomology H^1

cycle-generators.description: the homology class decomposes as a sum of cosheaf-homology generators e^_mu, one per non-Scott-continuous firing ordinal mu in L_ns(kappa), each dual to a sheaf-cohomology generator e_mu

indexed-by.description: L_ns(kappa) for closure ordinal kappa >= omega_1

non-collapsible.description: each e^_mu is a cosheaf 1-cycle that is not a boundary; local-to-global aggregation cannot collapse it without erasing the firing event

verdier-duality.description: the defining identification cl-inv^(v) := D_sp(cl-inv(v)), realizing H^1(F_v) ~= H_1(F^_v) via spatial Verdier duality on the bitopological settling site; the two presentations encode the same MLD-class
